changes: Rebuilt the original 1962–2001 period together with fiscal years 2002–2006 from the same named, read-only local sources. Compustat input extends through FYEAR 2007 for CFO at t+1 in baseline FYEAR 2006; the same FX inputs extend through 2008-12-31 to cover those reporting dates. CRSP/FF daily inputs extend through 2008-12-31; FFI49/support fits and S34 RDATE inputs extend through 2006. The original lags, leads, five-year windows, currency rules, screens, transformations, and Eq. (7) estimator are retained.
Kept FYEAR through each SAS handoff and added Stata e(sample) counts split at the original 2001 endpoint, plus a computed last added FYEAR, in each assigned baseline cell.

Checked the current local source dates and physical file modification times using the exact catalog-listed files; no alternate or acquired data were used. The fresh SAS and Stata outputs are job-local.
limitations: The source leaves the instrument set, GMM weighting details, and panel covariance ordering unspecified. The fitted regressors are used as instruments; in this exactly identified linear equation the OLS coefficient solution with panel HAC is equivalent to those moments.

Local eligible samples differ from the published counts and complete-case regression samples are smaller because source analyst and institutional ownership observations are missing. The exact source of the published-count discrepancy is unresolved; no source-vintage attribution is asserted.

Data mappings, annual volatility coverage, currency translation, company-level market equity, and historical links are best effort from local Compustat, CRSP, IBES, holdings, and Fama–French sources; see design.md and review.md.
Non-USD accounting amounts require positive unique same-date Xpressfeed GBP-to-source and GBP-to-USD legs. Unavailable or ambiguous FX legs remain missing; no historical rates are imputed.

Company market equity sums all common issues only when the effective CCM/CRSP PERMCO mapping is unique and all active issues have valid quotes on one date within 30 days of the three-month target. Ambiguous mappings and incomplete quote sets leave MVE unavailable.

FREV2A subtracts MEDEST only for identical nonmissing IBES CURCODE values; the source paper does not state currency treatment, and 37 cross-currency pairs were identified in the bounded matched-pair diagnostic.

S34 retains the earliest FDATE at MGRNO/RDATE grain and all holdings from that vintage. SHARES is converted from FDATE to the CRSP RDATE-month share basis with CFACSHR(FDATE)/CFACSHR(RDATE month); this is a documented best-effort vintage choice because the paper does not specify the vendor or filing vintage.

Although raw source dates extend beyond 2006, complete-case Eq. (7) estimation observations stop at FYEAR 2003 under the accepted construction: in every eligible DD and ABACC² firm-year for 2004–2006, lagged FREV2A and NANAL and their time interactions are missing. The source-date audit finds IBES rows in those years, but the existing IBES matching path produces no usable values for these baseline controls; no alternative link or imputation was introduced. See work/artifacts/period_complete_case_audit.csv.

The SAS log contains a nonfatal warning that missing arguments to INTNX returned missing values during fiscal-month assembly. The controller completed both sample handoffs and both Stata fits; the warning and its native log are retained.

The two Stata cells computed the required counts and years, but the display format omitted a separator between added_n and last_added. The native lines read `EXT_SAMPLE s1 27363 17802003` and `EXT_SAMPLE s2 30594 19392003`; separate count output and year tabs show 1,780/1,939 added observations through 2003. Because the controller requires an exact parseable marker and a second scientific launch is prohibited, both rows are reported as unverified and their structured count fields/artifacts remain empty.

The original-versus-extended t_eq comparisons retain the same model term and estimator, but the extension also uses current local source vintages and recomputes pooled winsorization/support fits across the enlarged period; the difference is not a vintage-controlled horizon effect.
